cause: a court started by hand outside its unit (court serve --db /tmp/court-try.db) still holds 127.0.0.1:4410, so hive-court.service fails to bind ("address already in use") and the frame's drone talks to the hand-run court and its throwaway database instead of the real one
cures_ok: read the holder's pid and command line (ss -ltnp, ps), end that pid with a plain SIGTERM (kill PID), then restart hive-court.service
